name: flow-2034-hunt
notes: Stand-in player that attacks: two years from the 2034 save with the Resistance run by the bot (ai.bot hunt,merge,reinforce) and given 60 ships of its best design at Earth on day 0 (about 3,000 SCV, enough to beat one alien raid fleet or a small station) and 40 more every 180 days, as a player who keeps building would have. The bot sends idle fleets at alien stations and parked fleets it outguns. Run repeated with a vanilla arm (probes.ps1 -Runs 3 -WithVanilla). Asserts are health checks and that the bot did attack; the info lines are the observations.
info: [(e['fleet'], e['scv'], e['at']) for e in events('inject', cmd='spawnfleet')]
(count('bot', ev='hunt'), count('order', why='bot:hunt', order='move', ok=True), count('order', order='DestroyHabOperation'), count('order', order='approach'), count('order', why='bot:home'))
[(e['t'], e['fleet'], round(e['scv']), e['target'], e['station'], e['system'], round(e['defence']), e['eta']) for e in events('bot', ev='hunt')][:25]

(count('combat', attacker='ResistCouncil', occurred=True), count('combat', attacker='ResistCouncil', occurred=True, winner='ResistCouncil'), count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True), count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True, winner='AlienCouncil'))
[(e['t'], e['idle'][:3], e['prey'], e['nearest'][:5]) for e in events('bot', ev='hunt-scan')][::6]

[(r['t'][:7], round(faction(r, 'ResistCouncil').get('scv', 0)), round(faction(r, 'AlienCouncil').get('scv', 0)), round(sum(faction(r, f).get('scv', 0) for f in ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']))) for r in metrics][::3]
(count('combat', occurred=True), count('combat', occurred=True, winner='AlienCouncil'), count('combat', occurred=True, winner='ResistCouncil'))
(count('combat', attacker='ResistCouncil', occurred=True), count('combat', attacker='ResistCouncil', occurred=True, winner='ResistCouncil'))
[(e['t'][:7], e['bases'], e['cap'], round(e['drip'], 1), round(e['upkeep'], 1), e['stock']['Exotics'], e.get('warChest'), e.get('largeFactor')) for e in events('economy')][::3]
median([r['scv'] / r['defThreat'] for r in events('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet') if r.get('defThreat')] or [0])
(count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True), count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True, winner='AlienCouncil'))
(count('trade', to='AlienCouncil'), sum(e['resources'].get('Metals', 0) for e in events('trade', to='AlienCouncil')))
[(f['faction'], round(f['contempt'], 2)) for f in events('disposition')[-1]['factions']] if count('disposition') else None

{f: (faction(first, f).get('scv'), faction(last, f).get('scv'), faction(last, f).get('ships')) for f in ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}
{r: count('human-market', ok=True, resource=r) for r in ['Metals', 'NobleMetals', 'Water']}

{f: (faction(first, f).get('bases', 0) + faction(first, f).get('stations', 0), faction(last, f).get('bases', 0) + faction(last, f).get('stations', 0)) for f in ['ResistCouncil'] + ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}
